verdicts.tldr: plan accepts and advertises ten flags it never reads, so a misplaced render flag is silently ignored
verdicts.details: run() builds one FlagSet before it switches on the subcommand (main.go:63-79), so plan registers all thirteen flags. plan reads exactly three of them: -root and -changed feed findRoot/readLines, -max-realms feeds BuildPlan(cfg.root, changed, cfg.maxRealms) at main.go:91. The other ten (-out, -gnodev, -port, -live, -base-root, -base-url, -pr, -max-pages, -chrome, -timeout) are read only inside render(). The finder named eight; -live and -max-pages are unread by plan too. A CI author who puts a render flag on the plan step, or misspells its value, gets exit 0 and no warning, and which flags a subcommand honours is discoverable only by reading render(). Fix: register the shared flags (-root, -changed, -max-realms) on both, and the render-only ten on the render FlagSet alone, after the switch on cmd.
verdicts.evidence: Built from the branch source: cd misc/gnopreview && go build -o /tmp/gnopreview . Then `gnopreview plan -h` prints -base-root, -base-url, -chrome, -gnodev, -live, -max-pages, -out, -port, -pr, -timeout beside -root/-changed/-max-realms; and `gnopreview plan -chrome /nonexistent -port 1 -timeout 1s -out /nope -base-url http://x -pr 9 -gnodev /nonexistent -base-root /nope -root <tree> -changed /dev/null` answers {"gnoweb":false,...,"realms":[],"dropped":0,"dirs":null} with exit=0.
verdicts.verify_by: go build -o /tmp/gnopreview . && /tmp/gnopreview plan -h (expect only -root/-changed/-max-realms/-live; observe all thirteen) && /tmp/gnopreview plan -chrome /nonexistent -port 1 -out /nope -root <tree> -changed /dev/null

verdicts.tldr: the gnodev logs are written into -out, the directory that gets published, and only a hardcoded rm in another repository file keeps them off the site
verdicts.details: startGnodev creates its log at filepath.Join(cfg.out, logName) (main.go:183), so a render leaves gnodev.log — and gnodev-base.log when a base pass runs — inside the tree pr-preview.yml uploads as the artifact. The only thing removing them is `rm -rf _preview/gnodev.log _preview/gnodev-base.log _preview/.gnodev-*` at pr-preview.yml:103, three hardcoded names in a different file: a renamed log, a fourth scratch file, or any second caller publishes them. The keybase half of the claim is refuted: gnodev never creates the -home directory. setup_address_book.go:18 reads `} else if !osm.DirExists(cfg.home) {` and only warns, so -home is import-only and nothing named .gnodev-<port> appears in -out or anywhere else. The chdir mechanism is real — gnopreview passes -home as the relative `_preview/.gnodev-8899` beside `-C <root>/examples`, and execLocalApp does os.Chdir(cfg.chdir) at command_local.go:87-89 before the config is consumed — but it makes the flag inert rather than misplacing a directory, which also means the collision main.go:173-176 says it is avoiding ($GNOHOME shared by the two passes) cannot happen. Fix: give render a work dir of its own (os.MkdirTemp or a -work flag) for both logs, so -out holds only what is meant to be served, and drop -home with the paragraph justifying it.
verdicts.evidence: tests/judge-173-out-scratch.sh, run at head with a stub gnodev that records its argv: '--- what landed in the published directory ---' lists gnodev.log; the argv shows 'ARG=-home' / 'ARG=_preview/.gnodev-8899' then 'ARG=-C' / '<root>/examples'; and the find over _preview and examples for '.gnodev-*' prints no line, at head or after the run.
verdicts.verify_by: grep -n 'rm -rf _preview' .github/workflows/pr-preview.yml, then grep -n 'cfg.out' misc/gnopreview/main.go to list what render writes there | grep -n 'os.Chdir' contribs/gnodev/command_local.go and the -home registration in contribs/gnodev/app_config.go:63; then run `gnopreview render -out _preview` from the repo root and `ls examples/_preview/`

verdicts.tldr: the base pass repeats the head pass's boot-crawl-write sequence, and the copies have already drifted on the empty-realm guard
verdicts.details: render() runs startGnodev, a Crawler literal, waitReady(base, urlOf(realms[0]), cfg.timeout, died), Run and Write at main.go:117-140; renderBase() runs the same five steps at 251-279, differing only in tree, port, log name, Crawler fields and error handling. The drift the candidate predicts is already in the file: renderBase guards its realms[0] probe with `if len(realms) == 0 { return nil, newRealms }` at 248, while render's plan.Realms[0] at 131 is not guarded — plan.Empty() returns early only when !Gnoweb && len(Realms)==0, and BuildPlan seeds gnowebSeedRealms behind `pkgs[r] != nil`, so a gnoweb-only plan whose four seed realms have all been renamed out of examples/ reaches 131 with an empty slice. Fix: one crawlTree(cfg, c, tree, dirs, port, logName, assets) holding the sequence and the guard once, with render() and renderBase() differing only in their arguments.
verdicts.evidence: tests/judge-174-crawl-helper.patch applied at head: gofmt -l . silent, go build ./... ok, go test ./... -> 'ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.004s'. git diff --numstat: 27 insertions, 31 deletions in main.go. render() 58 -> 46 lines, renderBase() 50 -> 35, crawlTree 17: the 108 lines carrying the duplicated sequence become 99 with one copy of it. Nothing downstream needs the head gnodev after Write — shots.go:158-163 serves the written tree over its own http.FileServer.
verdicts.verify_by: read main.go:117-140 beside main.go:252-279; both call startGnodev, build a Crawler, call waitReady(base, urlOf(realms[0]), cfg.timeout, died), Run and Write in that order
